newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iranian foreign minister says Iran will not abandon three disputed islands in the Gulf.
- Saudi Arabia has about 2,476 plants with total investment of $43.5 billion, study shows.
- Iran's president says Tehran has nothing to do with Khobar bomb blast in which 19 U.S. servicemen were killed in June.
- Kuwait tries to convince Bahrain to release the two Qataris held in Bahrain on spying charges.
- Kuwaiti Transportation Company sells three of its old tankers.
